content:
Ava: Hey folks — quick idea for Friday: let's run a short hands-on of Steam Link on phones/tablets using the spare GPU box in the mezz. Goal: see if hybrid 'handheld client + local host' gets playable input lag for couch co-op. @here :video_game:
Jordan: Nice, I’m in. Which controllers should we test? Steam Link works with Steam Deck, right?
Ava: Yea, Deck and Bluetooth controllers. Best results when controller is paired to the client device (phone/tablet).
Sam: I can bring a Pixel 6 and the Steam Link beta APK. Also have a USB-C -> ethernet dongle if we need wired.
Kyle: Wired is strongly preferred for latency. I can grab the spare PoE switch and a few short cables from storage and run one to the mezz table.
Nina: Might also try PS Remote Play as a side comparison — curious how DualSense passthrough performs. Not necessary but could be fun.
Ava: Plan: 6pm Friday, mezzanine. Bring a powerbank + cable if you're using a phone. I’ll bring the host machine (192.168.10.42) and a short HDMI so we can mirror the host and watch.
Jordan: Pro tips: enable Low Latency mode in Steam Link, turn off VSync on the host, and try 60fps mode if the client can handle it.
Sam: Also try "Prioritize network" on the host Steam client. I’ll test TowerFall (local co-op) and Streets of Rage 4 for input-sensitive comparisons.
Kyle: I’ll bring the switch + cables. Who’s got spare controllers we can borrow?
Nina: I’ve got a DualSense and a couple of 8BitDo pads I can bring.
Ava: Awesome — if anyone has a Steam Deck please bring it so we can compare native vs Steam Link on handhelds.
event-bot: Event created: "Steam Link handheld test" Friday 18:00 — mezzanine. RSVP: https://calendar.company/ev/steamlinktest
Jordan: :thumbsup: See you Friday.
Sam: pumped :rocket:
